faq.q: What is a before and after video maker?
faq.a: A tool that builds a short change-ad from a product photo, a prompt, or a product link. Script, presenter, voice, captions, and the edit are part of the clip. Show a change your product really makes to an item or the space around it, not a health, skin, or body result.

faq.q: How do I make a before and after video?
faq.a: Add a product link or a photo, name the start and the result, then download or publish. You can edit the script, the captions, and the music in the built-in editor before it goes out.

faq.q: Which maker should I use for this kind of ad?
faq.a: Use AIVideosUGC when you want several before and after versions from photos or links you already have, in the frames TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and Meta use.

faq.q: Is a before and after video free to make?
faq.a: No. Plans start at $24.50 a month. A 6-second clip uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60, and 30 seconds uses 120. You see that cost before the job starts, and a failed job returns the credits.
Yes. Finished clips can run as paid or organic ads and carry no watermark.

faq.q: Which frames can I publish, and where?
faq.a: Choose 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. You can also switch the spoken line and the captions to another language and pick a matching voice. Send the file to TikTok or Meta from the editor, or download it.

faq.q: Can I make one for every product at once?
faq.a: Yes. Add a group of photos or product links and get a clip for each item. Every clip spends its own credits. A store can also send photos through the API and take the clips back.

faq.q: Will this do as well as filming the change?
faq.a: Results vary by product and audience. Many shops use these clips to try hooks quickly, and still film a hero spot when they want a real set.

faq.q: Will TikTok or Meta reject an AI before and after ad?
faq.a: Check the current rule before you spend more. Some placements ask for a label when a clip could be read as a real customer. Anyone on screen is a generated presenter, not a buyer.
